Hi! I’m Ethan, an undergraduate studying **aquatic biology** at **Univeristy of California, Santa Barbara**. I’m passionate about **marine conservation, the study of biological processes**, and turning ideas into practical, well-designed projects.

Right now, I’m exploring preservation of native birds to the Santa Barbara coastline, and building my skills in outreach and the R programming language. Outside the classroom, you can usually find me reading books, scuba diving, and trying new teas.

Take a look at my recent work on the **Projects** page, or feel free to reach out—I’d love to connect!
